text:
adeeb: Observed weird role-bleed when converting HF jinja chat_template -> Redwood prompt during a new model bring-up. Some conditional blocks that render empty cause the system sentinel to get glued to the following user message, which then trips tokenization and leads to strange outputs.

adeeb: Minimal example HF template we used:
```jinja
{% if system_inject %}
- role: system
  content: "{{ system_inject }}"
{% endif %}
- role: user
  content: "{{ user_input }}"
```

adeeb: When `system_inject` is empty the converter produced this payload:
```
<|system|>
- role: user
content: "Hello"
```
which got flattened into the prompt as `"<|system|>- role: user"` and the tokenizer turned that into weird token sequences.

maria: That's probably why the quantized int8 run had those hallucination spikes yesterday. Any tokenizer dumps/ids? :eyes:

sam: Pasted a quick tokenizer dump. When conditional yields a blank line the `system` sentinel `'<|system|>'` remains as raw token and our renderer doesn't add the Redwood delimiter, so whitespace gets merged. Token snippet:
``
['<|system|>', '\n', '- role:', ' user'] -> [50256, 13, ...]
``
Whitespace/token boundary is the culprit.

luis: config.json role_map currently has `"system": "<|system|>"`. Our function `chat_template_to_prompt()` strips empty branches rather than replacing them with explicit role separators. I'll add a placeholder sentinel when a block is omitted so downstream stays consistent.

eval-bot: quick-compare run #3412 results:
- perplexity on eval set: baseline 18.2 -> patched render 17.9
- response drift (BLEU): baseline 2.4% -> patched 1.1%
(quantized int8 still shows small regression but reduced magnitude)

maria: Can we add a unit test for empty `if/endif` branches and a small integration test that goes through the quantized runtime?

sam: I'll open a PR with unit tests + tokenizer boundary guard. Adding an integration test that feeds the rendered prompt through the quantized runtime and checks for sentinel tokens in token ids. Assigning to @luis for review.

adeeb: Plan: sam PR -> luis review -> Maria runs full quantized eval -> merge. If regressions persist we fallback to explicit system injection only when non-empty. ack? :thumbsup:

luis: ack, starting review now.
